bullets.content: [general] Change ONE factor per solve (h or one refinement size/box, never both) and record the compare value. Runs mixing h with box/edge/root/pocket sizes gave 6.5-9% compare differences that could not be attributed. For a cheaper mesh, change one size per solve.

[general] Use all 4 solves. After each, view(kind=error, view=-z), read hotspot local h (if >1.3x requested size the refinement is swallowed: shrink size, not extent), and compare(n-1,n). Don't submit after a 9% compare diff.

[general] After every solve, read the top-5 hotspots (local h, share) and call view(solve, kind=error, view=iso); this was promised and not done, and the clamp ring was hidden as the second-largest error band. If a hotspot has local h above 2x the median, refine it.
[general] REPEATED: solve 4 was left unused twice. Never end a run with a meshed-but-unsolved candidate; a cheaper re-mesh of your best recipe is always a valid solve 4.

[general] Before submit, compute the score for EVERY candidate: e_est = 1.2 x error estimate, g = automesher error / e_est, score = (g/2)^2 / (DOFs/automesher DOFs). Don't pick by feel; a5 submitted solve 2 while solve 4 had more energy.
[general] Score = (g/2)^2 / DOF ratio. Compute per candidate before submitting (e.g. g 2.89, DOF ratio 1.96 gives 0.80). Once g exceeds ~2.5x, choose the cheaper mesh (g~2.3 scores higher).
[general] Calibration (bc0 gen5, estimate): +0.03% strain energy ≈ -1% field error near 8.4%. Above target accept a change only if dSE% x 33 > dDOF%.

[general] compare(a,b) gives the change between two solves, NOT the error of either. Two meshes sharing a coarse far field can agree and both be wrong. Combine compare with hotspots and the strain-energy trend before submitting.
[general] When field error is within about 1 point of the 2x target, stay on the safe side: missing the target costs quadratically (g^2), while a few % extra DOFs costs only linearly.
[general] Never spend DOFs chasing a guessed hidden check point when field error binds. Place refinements only on hotspots from your own error map, at least 1.4x finer than the surrounding size.

[general] Before extending a refinement box, compare coordinates of every top-6 hotspot with the box limits. Extend toward the side holding the largest error share, not the nearest hotspot (a5 extended -y while the 13% hotspot sat at +y).
[general] Check the DOF count against the automesher before solving. 13k DOFs at h 0.007 showed h doesn't drive DOFs; curvature and small features do. Use a large h with local refinements.
[general] Don't solve a mesh whose node count moved opposite to the intended change (coarser h but more nodes): mesher fallback. Re-mesh at a neighbouring h instead; this wasted one of four solves.
[general] Run single-factor tests on the base you intend to submit (e.g. h 0.0055), not on a coarser base already shown worse.
[general] Before solving, mesh and read the element-size lines: a box requested at 0.0033 gave local h 0.0038-0.0041. Verify the size actually reached the hotspots.

[abc_00000065_bc0] h-only variant: free-mesh h 0.0064/0.0066/0.0068/0.0070/0.0072, log nodes and q.min (reject q<0.105; nudge h by ±0.0002 rather than touch boxes). Baseline 5765 nodes, SE 2.13519e-4, field 8.30%, points 8.35%. Copy a6's free h-scan method.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Never coarsen h above 0.0074 on this recipe: h 0.0076 gave 6157 nodes vs 5691 at 0.0074; a6 got 6784 at 0.0082, 6425 at 0.0095, 6256 at 0.0112. Coarser h switches mesher branch and adds nodes.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Points and field tied (8.35% vs 8.30%); point RMS swung 5.49%→8.35% between near-identical root meshes. Finer h 0.0068 tightens the far strip along f52/f13 and may steady points (estimate).

[abc_00000065_bc0] Use all 4 solves (two unused is a repeat; also run inspect_geometry): S1 h 0.0068, S2 second h from scan (0.0064 or 0.0071, lowest-node valid), S3 cheaper variant (root 0.0028) to test the DOF tradeoff or best remaining; then compare(best, runner-up) and view(error) after each.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Accept an h only if dSE% ≥ 0.03×dDOF% vs baseline 2.13519e-4 at 17295 DOFs (+5% nodes needs ≥2.1384e-4). Else submit cheapest valid solve with SE ≥2.134e-4. Above target score ~ g/(2c): report each candidate's estimated base.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Sub-box 0.0016→0.0014 bought only +0.0146% SE for +2.2% nodes (break-even 0.03); delivered h 0.0021-0.0023. Don't tighten f5/f7 sub-boxes below 0.0016 unless in the base recipe.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Arc-end coverage pays: extending f7 sub-box y -0.008→-0.0145 gave +0.044% SE for +1.3% nodes. With 0.0014 it gave 5765 nodes, field 8.3%, q.min 0.112: valid low-node base. Hotspots #1-#6 at h 0.0021-0.0030.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Untested: +y arc ends hold 19.4% of error at h 0.0028 (f7 y≈+0.008 13%, f5 y≈+0.0064 6.4%). Extend f7 sub-box to y 0.0095 and f5 to y 0.0085 at 0.0016; expect h ≤0.0023. Not in the h-only variant.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Sub-box 0.0018 and 0.002 inside root 0.0025 at h 0.0074 gave q.min 0.0787 (invalid).

[abc_00000065_bc0] Score limited by cost (0.509), not accuracy (g 2.89 vs 2). Plan: cut DOFs ~20% to 14k by root box 0.0025→0.0028 keeping 0.0014 sub-boxes; expect ~10% field error, still beating target.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Pocket and f13 far-field cells show 70-320% local error but ~2% energy each: don't spend DOFs. Far faces f6, f52, f3 at h 0.006-0.0073 stay.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Variant on a1's recipe: change ONLY f5/f7 sub-box size 0.0016→0.0013 (baseline 5571 nodes, SE 2.13394e-4, field 8.45%; don't re-solve). If nodes >~5900 or q.min <0.105 try 0.0014, then 0.0012. Expect hotspots #1-#4 to reach ≤0.0022.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Root error follows two arcs 1 mm above f12: f5 inner wall r≈0.020 and f7 outer wall r≈0.027. Sub-boxes cover only arc middles; ends (f7 y≈-0.013, f4 y≈+0.012) sit at h 0.0028-0.0031. Refine along root edges.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Explorer recipe: h 0.0074; wall 0.0035; root 0.0022; pocket 0.003; no sub-boxes, no f13 box; edges 22 and 18 at 0.0016 r0.003. Confirm 18 is the f5-f12 edge. Target nodes ≤5800, quality ≥0.105.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Edges 22/18 at 0.0016 r0.002 give only h 0.0027 at root hotspots (1.7x lag), same as 0.0016 boxes. Edge 18 spans the whole f5 arc: r0.003 gave 7807-9414 nodes. Never refine edge 18 whole; use a box over x 0.018-0.022, y -0.007..0.009.
[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] With edge refinement instead of sub-boxes, root box must stay 0.0022: 0.0026 lost 0.26% SE (≈-8% error) for ~5% fewer DOFs, a net loss.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Edge recipe (h 0.0072, wall 0.0035, root 0.0022, pocket 0.003, edges 22+18 0.0016 r0.002; 5859 nodes) gave best field 8.26%, points 5.49%, but 5% dearer than a1. Use as diversity/point-bonus fallback.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspot #6 near f2/f12 corner (x 0.014, y 0.018, z -0.0067) holds 3.2-3.8% at h 0.0045. Untested box [0.012,0.014,-0.0081,0.017,0.021,-0.005] at 0.0025; explorer only, not in size-only variants.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Mesher-branch noise dominates node counts: wall 0.0035→0.004 went 5961→5608 nodes at ~equal SE (2.13359e-4). Wall 0.004 is an untested cost-saver on a1's recipe. Never wall 0.0048 (SE 2.13191e-4, worse).

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Each recipe has a low-node mesher branch near h 0.0073-0.0074 (a7: 5657 at 0.0074 vs 5720 at 0.007, 6227 at 0.0072). Free-mesh 0.0072, 0.0073, 0.0074, 0.0076; solve fewest-node with q≥0.105.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Widening f5 sub-box to y ±0.010 cost +630 nodes for +0.06% SE (a2, a5 identical mesh). Don't re-run. The f13 top box at 0.003 inside the 0.0035 wall box gave +0.12% SE for +1.8% DOFs; drop it.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Edge recipe 8.26% at 17.6k DOFs: g 2.9x, DOFs overspent (score 0.795 at 2.0x DOF ratio). Aim ~11% at 12-13k DOFs: edges 0.0020 or root 0.0025; cutting DOFs 25% for 2 pts error should score higher.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Worst hidden points: near f13 (~10-15%), P1 -11.4%, and near f12 (0.015,-0.0375,-0.006) 7.1%, in low-stress far field. Point error (5.5%) < field, so field binds: spend nothing there unless point error is within 1 pt of field. f13 0.0045 r0.004 only then.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Never set wall box above 0.0035: 0.004 left f5 at h 0.00525 and point error 8.82% (a7 at 0.0035: 6.17%). At coarse global h the point term binds first.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Root box below 0.0022 doesn't pay: 0.0018 raised SE only 0.32% for +18% DOFs (17.0k to 20.1k). Keep root 0.0022 (hotspot h ~0.0028-0.0030).

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Mesher is non-monotone in h: a7's h 0.006-0.009 all gave more nodes than 0.007; h 0.01 gave 7034 vs 6697. Mesh (free) at h 0.012, 0.011, 0.013, 0.0115 first; solve lowest node count with min quality >=0.1.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] With pressure load, strain energy rises toward its converged value as the mesh improves: free convergence check. a5's 2.105e-4 was below a7's 2.115e-4 and a0's 2.119e-4. Prefer higher strain energy per DOF.
